facts.fact: CoST reports Kaduna State Government launched its Infrastructure Portal (ipdata.kdsg.gov.ng) on 7 October 2025, publishing data on almost 1,500 projects in the OC4IDS standard and open to all.

NGA.note: No consultation on a digital law or policy is described.
OC4IDS is an international data standard used by a state portal, not a national standard issued by a standards body.
